nodes.summary: A set $E \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ has a rising sun decomposition for a function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ if there are sequences $(c_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ and $(d_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of real numbers such that $E$ is the union of the open intervals $(c_n, d_n)$, these intervals are pairwise disjoint, and $f(c_n) \le f(d_n)$ for every $n$.
nodes.title: Rising sun decomposition

nodes.summary: Let $a, b$ be real numbers, let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, and let $S$ be the rising sun set of $f$ on $(a, b)$. Then $f$ has the rising sun property on $[a, b]$ if $S$ is open, $S$ is empty if and only if $f$ is antitone (non-increasing) on $[a, b]$, and, whenever $S$ is nonempty, $S$ has a rising sun decomposition for $f$.
nodes.title: Rising sun property

nodes.summary: Let $a < b$ be real numbers and let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $[a, b]$. Then $f$ has the rising sun property on $[a, b]$.
nodes.title: Riesz's rising sun lemma

nodes.summary: For real numbers $a, b$ and a function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, the rising sun set of $f$ on $(a, b)$ is the set of points $x \in (a, b)$ for which there is some $t$ with $x < t \le b$ and $f(x) < f(t)$.
nodes.title: Rising sun set

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
